summary: Thickness, environment, age and a link to fossil richness are available per unit in Macrostrat (27,034 North American units with 49,266 linked PBDB collections) and PBDB collections carry environment and occurrence counts. The independent subsidence variable is the gap: only the backstripping software pyBacktrack and a few single-basin datasets were found, no open table of subsidence histories matched to units.
next_step: Pick basins with published subsidence curves (or run pyBacktrack on public well data), then join basin-level subsidence to Macrostrat columns and PBDB collection counts; verify server-side filters on Macrostrat before bulk queries.
obstacles_confirmed: No open global dataset of independent tectonic subsidence histories matched to formations.
At least some Macrostrat units lack environment data (a sampled unit had an empty environ list with the note 'environ- no data located').
